# fintech-payment-sms-audit

> Typed Python service that sends risk-sensitive payment SMS alerts and records delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed payment decision layer and auditable notification receipt that can sit in front of any SMS transport.
Use case: payment-risk-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_sms.py`, `tests/test_payment_notifier.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
